hints.title: Monotonic Substring Existence
hints.text: If a repeating substring of length L exists, any of its prefixes of length less than L also repeats. This monotonicity enables logarithmic search on candidate length L.

hints.title: Duplicate Occurrence Detection
hints.text: For a chosen length L, slide a window across the string and record seen substrings to check if any duplicate appears at least twice.

hints.title: Range Bounding
hints.text: Search on length in range [1, n - 1]. If a length repeats, store it as the best found and try larger lengths; otherwise reduce the search range.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking all pairs of substrings directly takes O(N^3) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Logarithmic search on length reduces evaluations to log N passes over substrings.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize monotonicity on substring length and use rolling hash or set slices.
complexity.notes: Can achieve O(N log N) using Rabin-Karp or O(N) using Suffix Automaton.
